approval_provenance.approved_scope: Record A01-A06 and prepare planning/control package only; no held-out cases.
approval_provenance.source: Current owner instruction WEEK 7 - GATE A OPERATIONAL DECISION RECORD AND AUTHORIZATION PREPARATION.

clauses: Project owner is accountable for source preparation, eligibility decisions and authorization.
Codex may assist with bounded preparation, mechanical validation and evidence-based ancestry recommendations when separately instructed.
ChatGPT may assist with explicitly owner-shared material.
Actual author/reviewer overlap and assistance must be documented.
No independence or AML expert-validation claim is authorized.
approved_decisions.title: Roles and responsibilities

clauses: Allowed: approved contracts, generic record conventions, authorized fictional policy and general AML knowledge.
Historical development cases, outputs, references and generator recipes may be used for disclosed ancestry comparison, not as undisclosed construction templates.
Source-only construction precedes ancestry review wherever operationally feasible.
No candidate model assessment, API request or feedback-driven case tuning during Gate A.
Record actual tool/context exposure, including unknowns.
approved_decisions.title: Permitted construction context

clauses: Every proposal receives mechanism-level ancestry screening.
Record material parent links, sibling/related-group relationships, exposure and uncertainty.
Cosmetic changes do not establish novelty.
Preserve the three existing eligibility dispositions.
Gate A screening remains provisional; F3 controls actual population release.
Quarantine unresolved material ancestry rather than silently treating it as unseen.
approved_decisions.title: Novelty and ancestry

clauses: Maximum six candidate proposals for the initial bounded pilot.
Maximum intended coverage of three substantively distinct mechanism families.
Working hours remain open and flexible.
Progress is based on verified checkpoints, not calendar deadlines.
Every proposal or variant consumes a slot, including rejected and quarantined proposals.
No automatic replacement or replenishment.
Stop early if review capacity, source quality or credible coverage is insufficient.
Any expansion requires a separately approved prospective amendment.
The ceiling is an engineering pilot limit, not a statistical power claim.
approved_decisions.title: Capacity and intake

clauses: Prefer the complete eligible roster from the bounded candidate intake.
Preserve all rejected, quarantined and eligible proposals in the intake history.
No outcome-dependent selection.
If sampling becomes necessary, obtain separate prospective approval for the selection unit, related-group handling and algorithm before using it.
Final eligibility and population release remain controlled by F3.
approved_decisions.title: Selection

clauses: Use compact versioned JSON evidence records with clear rationale where appropriate.
Record authorization, intake IDs, source identities, mechanism/ancestry, exposures, decisions, incidents and preservation.
Distinguish exact raw bytes from validated canonical representations.
Proposed project-local destination convention: outputs/evaluation/week-7/W7-HELDOUT-20261104-001/.
Preserve originals through non-overwriting versions or append-only evidence.
New Gate A records are not assumed to be covered by the existing F1 preservation archives.
Keep Gate A construction, F2 source/reference review, F3 population release and assessment execution as separate permissions.
approved_decisions.title: Evidence and sequence

authority_and_compatibility.earlier_draft_statuses: Historical pending/zero-rights wording in earlier documents is not rewritten. Later approved directions and exact F1 completion govern their respective scope.
authority_and_compatibility.exposure: Retain owner-confirmed v0.2 and C01-C04 uncertainties; no complete context history, independent authorship, blinding or expert status is inferred.
authority_and_compatibility.planning_versus_permission: Approval of these six operational decisions does not grant Gate A authoring, F2/F3 release or execution.
authority_and_compatibility.policy_and_measurement: Keep the as-configured comparison, unequal REF-01 policy access and original-candidate measurement boundary unchanged.
authority_and_compatibility.sampling: A05 does not waive PF04/OP06 prospective authoring/selection safeguards. No sampler, seed or algorithm is approved; an after-the-fact sampling fallback is not implicitly authorized.

document_binding_rule: This decision record binds earlier governing/F1 evidence only. The later draft operational specification may bind this record digest; no reciprocal or self digest is embedded.
prepared_by: Codex under the owner-approved bounded decision-record and authorization-preparation task.
preservation_boundary: This new record is local planning/control evidence outside existing F1 archive inventories. No new preservation copy, archive or upload is performed or implied.
serialization: UTF-8 without BOM; sorted keys; two-space indentation; finite JSON; LF plus terminal newline.
